Soft pieces

Vegetable shepherd's pie

Zöldséges pásztorpite

8 months+ Adjusted 55 min 6 portions

Spoon out a soft portion and mash it if the baby is not chewing well yet. The beans should crush, not stay firm.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 1 small onion (finely chopped)
  • 1 medium carrot (diced small)
  • 60 g peas (to be crushed)
  • 200 g cauliflower (half for the filling, half for the mash)
  • 80 g green beans (trimmed and cooked until soft)
  • 300 g potato (peeled and diced)
  • 60 ml whole milk (pasteurized)
  • 1 egg yolk (cooked through in the oven)
  • 10 g mild hard cheese (1 tablespoon, pasteurized, grated)
  • 1 tsp olive oil
  • 100 ml water (plain)

Allergens

milkegg

Method

  1. Soften the onion in the oil, then add the carrot, green beans, half the cauliflower, the peas, and the water.
  2. Cook until the beans and cauliflower are completely soft, then crush the peas, and add no salt.
  3. Boil the potato and the remaining cauliflower until tender, then mash them with the milk.
  4. Stir the egg yolk and the tablespoon of cheese into the mash, and add no nutmeg.
  5. Spread the mash over the ragout and bake at 190 C until the topping is hot and the yolk is fully set, about 20 minutes.
  6. Cool slightly and offer soft spoonfuls, mashed if the baby is not chewing yet.

Adjusted

The usual pie was salted, and nutmeg is often added to the potato topping. Green beans also stay fibrous if they are undercooked.

Bake an unsalted vegetable ragout under a potato and cauliflower mash bound with a little milk and one egg yolk, with no nutmeg. Cook the beans until soft, and keep the cheese to one tablespoon.
